repos.name: skyzh/tiny-llm
repos.description: learn LLM inference system on Apple Silicon for systems engineers: build a tiny vLLM + Qwen
repos.one_liner: A hands-on educational project for building a high-performance LLM inference engine from scratch on Apple Silicon.
bullets: Built using Python with a focus on low-level systems engineering principles.
Implements core inference components like KV cache, PagedAttention, and model quantization.
Designed to teach the architecture behind production-grade systems like vLLM.
Ideal for engineers looking to understand the hardware-software interface of LLM deployment.

repos.name: JimLiu/baoyu-design
repos.description: Run Claude Design locally as an Agent Skill — Cursor, Claude Code & more. Produce polished UI mockups, prototypes, decks & wireframes as self-contained HTML, without claude.ai/design. Best with Opus or Claude.
repos.one_liner: A local agent skill that enables Claude to generate professional UI mockups and prototypes directly in your development environment.
bullets: Operates as an agent skill compatible with Cursor and Claude Code.
Generates self-contained HTML/CSS/JS prototypes without relying on external design platforms.
Streamlines the design-to-code workflow by automating UI production via LLM.
Useful for rapid prototyping of fintech dashboards or internal enterprise tools.

repos.name: betterleaks/betterleaks
repos.one_liner: A high-performance infrastructure security tool designed to detect leaked secrets across distributed environments.
bullets: Written in Go for high-concurrency scanning and efficient resource utilization.
Automates the discovery of sensitive credentials, API keys, and tokens in codebases.
Essential for DevSecOps pipelines to prevent data breaches in cloud-native infrastructure.
Provides a scalable solution for monitoring enterprise-wide repositories for security regressions.

repos.name: jackwener/DeepseekHarness-Android
repos.description: 免 ROOT 免 Termux，一个 APK 在安卓手机上跑 DeepSeek Harness。引擎内嵌 App 进程 · 读屏操作 App · 改系统设置 · 定时/条件自动化 · 可选 Shizuku
repos.one_liner: An Android application that embeds an LLM harness to automate system-level tasks and screen interactions without root access.
bullets: Utilizes Kotlin and Shizuku to perform system-level automation on Android devices.
Enables agentic control over screen reading, app navigation, and system settings.
Demonstrates the potential for on-device AI agents to manage complex mobile workflows.
Applicable for building automated testing suites or personal productivity agents on mobile.

repos.name: lexifina/global-law
repos.description: Git for Global Law: the law of every country as one git history, each country's record a submodule, every commit one law taking effect
repos.one_liner: A version-controlled, global repository of legal codes using Git to track legislative changes across jurisdictions.
bullets: Uses Git submodules to organize and track the legal history of individual countries.
Treats every legislative update as a discrete commit, creating a verifiable audit trail of law.
Provides a structured data foundation for legal-tech applications and regulatory compliance monitoring.
Useful for quant researchers tracking regulatory shifts that impact financial markets.
repos.img_alt: How long each country's law waits between adoption and entry into force, one distribution per jurisdiction
